name: Inspect Image
description: Open an image in PhotoCraft and report its size, mode and layers. Use when someone asks what an image contains or how it is built.
author: RealmNest examples
permissions: opens the image file you name (inside PhotoCraft's read root)
reads the document structure; changes nothing

examples.title: Size and layers
examples.procedure: doc_open {path: "gradient.png"} → doc_inspect {} → answer with width × height, mode and the layer list, top to bottom
